violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Observed dough not in a covered container in the reach in cooler.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. Observed dough and cheese not date marked in the reach in cooler

General equipment and utensils - Use limitations of certain materials. — --Material of food contact equipment/utensil is not approved for use by food service code. Observed cinnamon roll dough stored in a grocery bag.--Material of food contact equipment/utensil is not approved for use by food service code. Observed sausage wrapped with dough in the freezer in a garbage bag.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Observed loose hanging debris from the filters on the ventilation system.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Donut bags and boxes were being stored on the floor in the kitchen and in the storage closet by the utility room.
